description: This file defines a service for managing chat interactions within an educational chatbot platform, including handling user messages, integrating retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) methods, and orchestrating multiple agents (tutor, grader, coach) to generate responses. It also interacts with a database interface to manage session state and messages.

methods.name: str _agent_responder(agent: str, user_message: str, passages: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Generates agent-specific responses based on the agent type and retrieved passages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] handle_chat( db: DatabaseInterface, user_id: str, session_id: Optional[str], user_message: str, agents: Optional[List[str]], context_ids: Optional[List[str]], metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], )
methods.description: Main function to process a user message, manage session state, retrieve context passages via RAG, orchestrate agent responses, and return the full message history along with used contextual passages.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ingest_text(text: str, title: Optional[str], metadata: Optional[Dict[str, Any]], namespace: str = "edu")
List[Dict[str,Any]] retrieve_passages(query: str, top_k: int = 5, filters: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, namespace: str = "edu")
